def ciel(x, y):
    if x % y:
        return x // y + 1
    return x // y

def what_should_be_the_logic():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    k = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    ma = 0
    cnt = 1
    for j in range(n - 1):
        for i in range(j + 1, n):
            if a[i] - a[j] <= k:
                cnt += 1
            else:
                if cnt > ma:
                    ma = cnt
                cnt = 1
        if cnt > ma:
            ma = cnt
        cnt = 1
    print(max(ma, cnt))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    what_should_be_the_logic()
